verdict.rationale: Decagon's Insights & Reporting product page confirms a dashboard with visual heatmaps and natural-language querying of conversations to spot trends, which supports general leader-facing analytics, but no evidence names or confirms specific metrics like CSAT, resolution rate, handoff rate, or cost per resolution being tracked or displayed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of CSAT tracking, resolution rate, handoff rate, and cost-per-resolution metrics, plus any exec-report templates or independent corroboration of these specific KPIs.
